nodes.title: A scripted card's board writes "?" only over the value the card asks: board-sync answerValues withholds the numbers of the KEY (scriptBeat.answers[0]) that her line does not state (as itself or an equal fraction), and never a label the card's own board authors ("before 2/4" over the card's 2/4 mark). Accept forms withhold nothing: they quote the card's givens ("5 wali roti ka tukda", "her brother, 4/6"); director7's rule withheld every number in key and accept forms and drew c5-t02's givens as "?". A fraction-line@1 asked `mark` whose value her line states is labelled with it (board-first statedMark); the card's board still on screen on her confirming turn stays a candidate (sameCard): re-taken, a value she now states is drawn, else it is kept. Reverse if a card's key is a given its own board must hide (Learning's check.mjs would then need a withhold field on the card).

Amends director5 SC2 (a picture request re-shows the live card's own board): when the card's own board is ALREADY the page on screen, a picture request draws a second view of the same numbers instead: fraction-bars@1 (1-3 equal bars, parts and shaded parts per bar, counts.wholes), chosen at preselect so her line is written from its row, and flagged artifact.altView = "parts" for Brain. Only a fraction line within one whole (marks, an asked mark, a hop) or a compare whose title or item IS a fraction gives one; the value the card withholds is an unshaded "?" bar. Anything else is re-shown as before, and with another board on screen SC2 stands unchanged (the card's board). The card's own board always answers a picture request, a words-only compare included (answersRequest skipped it, nothing was picked and the ladder drew an unrelated code board). Main approved 2026-11-06. Reverse if judges find the second view confuses a child more than it helps: go back to re-showing the card's board.

director8's own card turns (results on claude/r4-conversation 9dbf3101a: per-turn boardRef, card, screen) re-drawn with dc-r7-card-board-asked-only: turns whose board wrote "?" over a number the card states and its board authors, before → after: c5-t02 14/38 → 0, c5-t01 1/30 → 0, c4 0/30 → 0, c6 0/28 → 0. Of all 81 director8 turns that drew a "?", 42 still do: each an open question whose value her line has not stated. tests/r8-card-stated.test.mjs: every check and then-card of the 4 pilot scripts and Learning's 29 staged scripts draws no stated number as "?"; a picture request returns a figure on every pilot card and on all staged cards but 7, each a card whose prompt names a shape (circle, chord) over a words-only compare board (W15.named_shape_drawn; Learning data).

md.decisions:
## `dc-r7-card-board-asked-only`

A scripted card's board shows every number the card states; only the asked value is "?". The key's numbers are withheld unless her line states them (the spoken card is in her line) or the card's own board authors them as labels; accept forms quote the givens and withhold nothing. An asked mark on a fraction line is labelled once her line states its value, and the card's board still on screen on her confirming turn is re-taken (so the confirmed value appears) or kept, never replaced by the code's bare line. Reverse if a card's key is a given its own board must hide.

## `dc-r7-picture-second-view`

Amends SC2. A picture asked for while the card's own board is already up draws the same numbers as equal bars (fraction-bars@1, counts.wholes per bar, artifact.altView "parts"); the asked value is an unshaded "?" bar. Only for a fraction line within one whole or a compare whose entries are fractions; otherwise the card's board is re-shown, and with another board up the card's board is drawn (SC2 unchanged). The card's own board always answers a picture request. Reverse if judges find the second view confuses a child more than it helps.
md.measurements:
## `ms-r7-director8-card-question-replay-2026-11-06`

director8's card turns re-drawn with the asked-only rule: "?" over a stated, authored number c5-t02 14/38 → 0, c5-t01 1/30 → 0, c4 and c6 0 → 0; 42 of 81 "?" turns remain, each an open question. tests/r8-card-stated.test.mjs covers the 4 pilot and 29 staged scripts; 7 staged cards (shape named in the prompt, words-only compare board) fail a picture request on W15 — Learning data.
